title: Neenello Naanalle
desc: Santosh meets a charming village girl and ends up falling for her when he returns to India with his mother for a wedding.

title: Kotee
desc: In the corrupt city of Janatha, Kotee, an honest man, defies the ruthless criminal Dinoo Savarkar in a bid to secure a better future for his sister. However, his defiance leads to overwhelming debts.

title: Madhagaja
desc: The wife of one of two rival dons sends her son to a distant land to shield him from their relentless feud. However, the son, raised as an orphan, eventually returns to the brutal world of violence.

title: Inspector Gabbar
desc: An honest police officer lives with his mother, stepfather and stepbrother. When a criminal, who intends to join politics, lures his stepbrother into the world of crime, he must go against him.

title: Maharaja
desc: Rajashekhar has two sons, Surya and Kiran, but Surya is adopted. Surya is very hardworking and makes many sacrifices for the family, thereby inciting jealousy in his brother Kiran's heart.
